description: Source code for the HP206C sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing functions for sensor initialization, configuration, and data acquisition via I2C.

methods.name: hp206c_bus_config
methods.description: Configures the I2C bus for the sensor device.

methods.name: hp206c_read
methods.description: Reads data from the sensor via I2C using a command.

methods.name: hp206c_read_reg
methods.description: Reads a specific register value from the sensor.

methods.name: hp206c_write
methods.description: Writes data to the sensor via I2C using a command.

methods.name: hp206c_write_reg
methods.description: Writes a value to a specific register.

methods.name: hp206c_cmd_send
methods.description: Sends a command to the sensor.

methods.name: hp206c_osr_set
methods.description: Sets the oversampling rate for the sensor.

methods.name: hp206c_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as oversampling and altitude offset.

methods.name: hp206c_wait_dev_ready
methods.description: Waits until the device is ready or timeout occurs.

methods.name: hp206c_buf_convert
methods.description: Converts raw buffer data to integer value.

methods.name: hp206c_val_get
methods.description: Retrieves sensor value for pressure, altitude, or temperature.

methods.name: hp206c_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves data for specified sensor channel.

methods.name: hp206c_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, resets chip, sets default oversampling and altitude offset.
